'''2001 UK National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held in the United Kingdom in 2001.<ref name="dt-15568">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15568 Dark Surgeon], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 24 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15568/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15568/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 24 April)
* '''Site:''' United Kingdom
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' —

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

== Results ==

Results below come from players' own DeckTech deck posts. Each row cites the post that gives it. A Dark or Light cell shows — until the deck page is linked.

Tennet's Dark Agents Of Black Sun deck, which he calls Dark Surgeon, did not lose a game at the UK National; he names Michael Riboulet as his game 4 opponent and describes a game 5 against a loaded Falcon.<ref name="dt-15568" /> For the previous year's event see [[2000 UK National Championship]].
